slides.headline: This week in India's growth story.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: Every week adds another piece.
slides.body: None of these stories are the whole picture on their own - the picture is what they add up to, one week at a time, for the next 20 years.
